notes.title: Synthrome Mega Update 1.51
notes.notes:
1.51 Hotfixes Patch

- Level Select now unlocks after beating the game
- Pause Menu bug solved
- Minor enhancements and polish in SYN City
- Minor bug fixes all around
- SynthFlyer City level - Fixed

notes.title: SYNTHROME MEGA Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]THE MEGA UPDATE IS HERE! WELCOME TO SYNTHROME 1.5!!![/b][/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work reimagining and rebuilding major parts of the game to deliver a smoother, faster, and more polished experience. Changelog below: 
[/p][h3][b]Redesigned Levels[/b][/h3][p]Multiple stages have been redesigned from the ground up, while others received a major tune-up. Expect tighter layouts, better pacing, and more exciting environments to blast through.[/p][h3][b]Gameplay Polished Top to Bottom[/b][/h3][p]From movement mechanics to physics tweaks, we've overhauled core systems for better responsiveness, smoother momentum, and a more satisfying gameplay loop.[/p][h3][b]Tutorial Rebuilt[/b][/h3][p]We heard you loud and clear, the tutorial now actually teaches the flying mechanic, your main tool of exploration and speed. It's fun, intuitive, and gets you soaring in no time.[/p][h3][b]AI Removal![/b][/h3][p]All placeholder AI models have been removed and replaced with proper in-universe designs, creating a more cohesive, original world.[/p][h3][b]Lore Logs, Collect & Discover[/b][/h3][p]Uncover the hidden history and story of SYNTHROME through collectible lore logs scattered across the world. Track your findings and dig deeper into the game's universe via the main menu.[/p][h3][b]SynthFlyer Rebooted[/b][/h3][p][b]Action Mode[/b]: Completely reprogrammed and rebuilt from the ground up.[/p][p][b]Exploration Mode[/b]: Tweaked and refined for smoother flow and better exploration.
[/p][list][*][p][b]New Animations & Character Models[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenge Mode Added[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Speedrunning Focus[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Boss Battles[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Save System[/b]
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Go ahead. Break the game. That’s the point.[/b][/p][p][b]This is the definitive version of SYNTHROME.[/b][/p][p][b]More polished. More stylish. More playable.[/b][/p][p][b]Welcome to SYNTHROME 1.5, The MEGA UPDATE.[/b][/p][p][b]Enjoy,[/b][/p][p][b]SFS Team[/b][/p]
